name: Felgur Twocuts
summary: At Ghost Walker Post, Felgur Twocuts watches the Horde’s struggle with Desolace’s centaur clans.

sections.title: A Gruff Outpost Scout
sections.body: At Ghost Walker Post in central Desolace, Felgur Twocuts keeps watch and spares little for pleasantries. As a forward scout for the Horde, he weighs the dangers facing travelers and settlers heading west through the mountains. The Kolkar centaur are foremost among them.

sections.title: War on the Centaur
sections.body: Felgur directs Horde champions against the local centaur chieftains. He also sends them to claim bounties on tribes that threaten to overrun the region. Those seeking to secure the Horde’s foothold in Desolace can turn to him.

faq.answer: Felgur Twocuts scouts for the Horde from its forward encampment at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace.

faq.q: Where can I find Felgur Twocuts?
faq.answer: Find Felgur Twocuts at Ghost Walker Post, just north of Desolace’s central road.

faq.q: What tasks does Felgur Twocuts give?
faq.answer: Felgur sends Horde adventurers after the local Kolkar centaur, Khan Dez'hepah, and hostile centaur with bounties on their heads.

faq.q: Why is Felgur so curt with visitors?
faq.answer: Desolace is a dangerous wasteland ringed by hostile centaur clans. At his isolated post, Felgur has little time for idle chatter and keeps his attention on survival and martial duty.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you can turn to Felgur at Ghost Walker Post for help driving back Desolace’s aggressive centaur tribes.
As an orc, you may recognize Felgur’s practical focus in dangerous borderlands. He values strength, speed, and immediate results over idle conversation.
